<<A Word About Mending Of Fishing Nets>>

It is important for our community to understand the role of mending fishing nets. When nets are damaged, they can lead to lost catch and increased effort for fishermen. By mending nets, we not only help preserve the livelihoods of those who rely on fishing but also protect the marine ecosystem. The community is encouraged to participate in net mending efforts, as it fosters cooperation and strengthens our shared responsibility for sustainable fishing practices. Let’s work together to ensure that our fishing nets are kept in good condition, so that we can continue to support our community and the environment.
